svg.title: Dreams: 12 functions named and checked
svg.desc: Early-stage Dreams research. 12 functions named and checked out of 9,551 code functions found so far. 4 reviewed functions still need an explanation; 9,535 have not been reviewed. Each square is one piece of code. Computer-generated code does not count as identified.

g.text: 0.13% of the 9,551 code functions found so far
Parts of these systems — work is ongoing
Each square is one function (a piece of code). Generated code still needs someone to work out what it does.
This tracks the functions found so far. It is not a percentage of the whole game rebuilt or fully understood.
